list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver_number FROM f1_car_data ORDER BY driver_number

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'car' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM f1_car_data UNION ALL SELECT 'location', COUNT(*) FROM f1_location_data UNION ALL SELECT 'position', COUNT(*) FROM f1_position_data UNION ALL SELECT 'intervals', COUNT(*) FROM f1_intervals_data

SELECT date AS time, speed AS value, CONCAT('Driver ', driver_number) AS metric FROM f1_car_data WHERE date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$driver' = 'All' OR driver_number = '$driver') ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time, throttle AS value, CONCAT('Throttle ', driver_number) AS metric FROM f1_car_data WHERE date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$driver' = 'All' OR driver_number = '$driver') ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time, brake AS value, CONCAT('Brake ', driver_number) AS metric FROM f1_car_data WHERE date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$driver' = 'All' OR driver_number = '$driver') ORDER BY date
SELECT date, driver_number, speed, rpm, n_gear, throttle, brake, drs, session_key FROM f1_car_data ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 100
